title: 印度央行守住97：但卢比不是趋势反转，几个月内还要到96
speaker: Charlie

segments.en: Yes, so um, I mean, I guess the policy signal is clear on my views
segments.zh: 是的，我认为政策信号在我的观点里是清晰的。

segments.en: They're basically saying that 97 is a line to send near term
segments.zh: 他们基本上在说，97是短期要守住的一条线。

segments.en: But from my perspective, I think the measures probably provide a near term relief
segments.zh: 但在我看来，这些措施可能提供短期缓解。

segments.en: But not a trend reversal when it comes to the R&R
segments.zh: 但对卢比来说并不是趋势反转。

segments.en: And our forecast is still for 96 in dollar R&R in top months time near term
segments.zh: 我们的预测仍是美元兑卢比在几个月内到96，短期。

segments.en: I guess we can be in a range of you know, 94.5 to 96.5
segments.zh: 我想我们可能处在94.5到96.5的区间。

segments.en: Um, I guess the fundamental has not changed um, we still faced, you know, a rise a high energy price environment
segments.zh: 我想基本面没有改变，我们仍面临高能源价格环境。

segments.en: That is negative for India trade balance
segments.zh: 这对印度贸易收支是负面的。

segments.en: Um, we also have, you know, rising inflation recently and even with the RBI hike rear rates is not negative
segments.zh: 近期通胀也在上升，即使印度央行加息，实际利率也不是负的。

segments.en: Um, and on top of that you have the structural concerns where India just doesn't quite had as much exposure
segments.zh: 除此之外还有结构性担忧，印度在这方面的敞口并不大。

segments.en: To the AI team as elsewhere in Asia, so I don't think the RBI measures changed that
segments.zh: 与亚洲其他地区相比，对AI主题的参与度不同，所以我不认为印度央行的措施改变了这一点。

segments.en: What it does say though is that the RBI is moving somewhat away from a heavy-handed direct effects intervention scheme
segments.zh: 但它确实表明，印度央行正在某种程度上从强力的直接外汇干预转向。

segments.en: To be to rely more on macro potential policy
segments.zh: 更多地依赖宏观审慎政策。
